file_info.description: Mode 3: Create standardized master face image from a user portrait

prompts.identity_core: Create a realistic studio portrait master image of the same person shown in [PERSON_IMG].
prompts.photo_style: Front-facing head-and-shoulders composition, neutral expression, clean background, soft even lighting, natural skin texture, identity-preserving facial details.
prompts.consistency_rule: Preserve face identity faithfully from [PERSON_IMG], including face shape, eye shape, nose, lips, and overall proportions. Avoid beautification that changes identity.
